label: 2D Mỹ · Cartoon
static_style:
American theatrical 2D cartoon animation aesthetic; expressive hand-drawn characters, confident flowing contours, clear shape language and strong readable silhouettes. Use appealing stylized proportions, flexible brows and mouths, and facial construction that supports a broad emotional range. Preserve each character’s specified age, identity and established design. Render characters with clean colour fills, economical cel shadows and selective highlights. Describe materials through graphic shapes, folds and purposeful line accents. Maintain a consistently drawn 2D appearance. Avoid photoreal textures, sculpted 3D surfaces and generic stock-vector or clip-art styling.

Environments should use designed, painted backgrounds with coherent perspective, selective brush texture and clear foreground, middle-ground and background separation. Coordinate scenery, props and characters through a shared shape language and colour palette. Follow the project’s established period, architecture, costumes and props. Draw atmospheric and magical effects as readable 2D forms with controlled visual complexity.

For narrative scenes, use clear value grouping, expressive colour design and simplified lighting motivated by sources within the setting. Keep faces, gestures and silhouettes easy to read. Create depth through staging, overlap, scale and multiplane composition, with restrained blur. For white-background asset references, use clean model-sheet presentation, neutral colours, minimal shading and consistent construction across every required view.
video_motion: For video, use expressive pose-to-pose animation with clear anticipation, rhythmic timing, purposeful squash and stretch, overlapping action and follow-through. Match exaggeration to the scene’s emotion. Use animation on twos where appropriate and ones for fast or fluid passages; allow brief smear drawings during rapid movement. Preserve character volume and return cleanly to the established design after deformations. Avoid mechanical puppet motion, arbitrary jitter, persistent off-model distortion and effects that obscure the performance.
